name: 王秋玄
objective: This course focuses on developing students’ creative ideation, design thinking, and hands-on implementation skills through project-based learning. Students will be guided through a complete design process, including observation, problem exploration, concept development, prototyping, implementation, and iterative refinement. The course emphasizes the relationships among users, media, interaction, and context, and encourages students to explore different forms of creation using 2D and 3D media, digital media, and interactive technologies. Through iterative design, testing, and refinement, students will strengthen their abilities in concept communication, interdisciplinary integration, problem-solving, and project development.
